title: refactor(incident-bot): restructure autodiagnostics runbook linking and SLO toolkit helpers
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Motivation: the incident-bot autodiagnostics flow and SLO toolkit runbook helpers had accumulated special-cased linking logic which led to duplicate lookups, inconsistent scoring of suggested runbooks, and flaky telemetry when a runbook was referenced from multiple SLO sources. This PR refactors the runbook linking layer into a single canonical service inside incident-bot and extracts common helpers into the slo-toolkit module to be reused by other on-call utilities.

What changed: consolidated runbook linking service, deterministic scoring for suggestions, persistent caching for recent lookups (LRU with TTL), improved telemetry (link origin + match score), added unit and integration tests, updated docs and example quicklinks.

Checklist:
- [x] Move linking logic into incident-bot/runbook_linker.ts
- [x] Extract common helpers to slo-toolkit/runbook_helpers.py and types into shared schema
- [x] Add telemetry hooks and metrics: runbook.link_attempts, runbook.link_success, runbook.match_score_histogram
- [x] Add caching with configurable TTL and metrics for cache hits/misses
- [x] Add end-to-end integration test against the oncall simulator
- [x] Update docs: docs/oncall/runbooks.md and console quicklink examples

Migration notes: the new linker exposes a compatible API so no runtime migration is required for existing consumers. Operators can tune the cache TTL via INCIDENT_BOT_LINKER_TTL_SECONDS. If operators previously relied on incidental side-effects of the older implementation (eg: duplicate suggestions from two different SLO sources), this change will produce de-duplicated suggestions.

Testing: added ~40 unit tests, 3 integration scenarios in ci/integration/oncall, manual validation with dev cluster runbook dataset (sample corpus ~7k runbooks). CI passed flakier e2e initially; reran e2e once to stabilize.

Rollout: feature guarded behind INCIDENT_BOT_ENABLE_NEW_LINKER (default true in main). Rolling out via canary on oncall-team namespace for 48h before global promotion.

Miguel Alvarez: match scoring looks good but add a unit test to cover the case where multiple SLOs reference overlapping runbooks (should de-dupe and prefer explicit source).
Author (Priya): Added a unit test 'de-dupe-multi-slo.spec' and adjusted scoring to bias explicit SLO reference by +0.1 score.

release_notes: Refactor incident-bot autodiagnostics linking and extract shared SLO toolkit helpers. Improves suggestion reliability, reduces duplicate runbook suggestions, and adds observability and caching. No API breaking changes.
